spans.s:
भुक् भुक्, ind., Ved. an exclamation of
surprise.

भुक्कभूपाल भुक्क-भूपाल, अस्, m., N. of
a king.
भुक्त भुक्त, भुक्ति. See p. 713, col. 3.

भुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, enjoyed, eaten; used, pos-
sessed; experienced, suffered; passed (as time);
(अम्), n. the thing eaten or enjoyed, food [cf. कु-
भ्˚]; the act of eating; the place where any person
has eaten.
—भुक्त-पूर्विन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who
has eaten before.
—भुक्त-भोग, अस्, आ, अम्,
one who has enjoyed an enjoyment or suffered a
suffering; made use of, used, employed, enjoyed.
—भुक्त-मात्रे, ind. immediately on having eaten.
—भुक्त-वृद्धि, इस्, f. the swelling of food (in
the stomach).
—भुक्त-शेष or भुक्त-शेषक
or भुक्त-समुज्झित, अम्, n. what is left after
eating, the remnants of a meal, leavings, orts.
—भुक्त-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping after a meal.
—भुक्तासव (˚त-अस्˚), अस्, m. (in astronomy) the
equivalent in respirations of the part of the sign
traversed.
—भुक्तोच्छिष्ट (˚त-उच्˚), अम्, n. the
rejected leavings or remnants of food (= फेलिका).

भुक्तवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has eaten or
possessed.

भुक्ति, इस्, f. the act of enjoying or eating, enjoy-
ment, eating; fruition, possession, usufruct; food; (in
astronomy) the daily motion of a planet [cf. पक्ष-
भ्˚, मास-भ्˚]; a limit [cf. तीर-भ्˚].
—भुक्ति-
पात्र, अम्, n. a dish for food.
—भुक्ति-प्रद, अस्,
m. the plant Phaseolus Mungo (= मुद्ग).
—भुक्-
ति-मती, f., N. of a river; (also read मुक्ति-मती.)
—भुक्ति-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, excluded from enjoy-
ment, not allowed to be enjoyed.

भुक्त्वा, ind. having enjoyed or eaten; having
possessed.
—भुक्त्वा-सुहित, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied
after eating.

भूक भूक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
rt. 1. भू), a cavity, hole, chasm; the cavity from
which a stream issues, the source of a stream, a
spring; time; (अस्), m. darkness.

भूकल भूकल, अस्, m. a restive or un-
manageable horse.
